pages.api:
# API reference

> The readings, the report, the store vector, the export endpoints and the settings.

## Reading `transcript/<name>` (default `reply0`)

`transcript.v1`, class `reading`: the answer as `text`; `start_ns` and `end_ns` both the command's start time; `confidence` always 1.0 (not measured).

## Calls made

`svc.infer/<service>` with `infer.v1`: `model`, `priority`, `max_tokens`, `system`, `text`.

## Reading `telemetry/<name>`

`telemetry.v1`: `commands`, `replies`, `failures`, `latency.mean` (ms), `bus.connected`.

## stdout

`{"command", "reply", "ok"}` per command, then one report per interval:

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | string | `ok`, `no_source`, `simulate`, `replay` |
| `provenance` | string | `MEASURED`, `SYNTHETIC` or `REPLAY` |
| `model`, `brain` | string | the alias; `svc.infer/<service>` or `synthetic` |
| `commands`, `replies`, `failures` | numbers | since start |
| `mean_latency_ms` | number | per answered command, service time included |
| `remembered_turns` | number | |
| `last_command`, `last_reply`, `last_error` | string/null | |
| `bus` | object | `connected`, `subscribed`, `published`, `error` |

## Store vector (id 35)

Eight floats; a source that is absent is **-1**.

| Slot | Name |
|---|---|
| 0 | `commands` |
| 1 | `replies` |
| 2 | `failures` |
| 3 | `mean_latency_ms` |
| 4 | `remembered_turns` |
| 5 | `published` |
| 6 | `bus_connected` |
| 7 | `answer_ratio` |

## Export (`http://127.0.0.1:8069`, continuous mode)

`/status`, `/raw`, `/history`, `/guide`, `/healthz`.

## Settings

`--interval`, `--window`, `--model`, `--service`, `--source`, `--name`, `--max-tokens`, `--priority`, `--history`, `--timeout-s`, `--api-bind`, `--replay`, `--simulate`.
pages.model:
# The model

> Which model answers, and what it is told.

The cog calls `svc.infer/<service>` (default `venq-npu`) with an `infer.v1` request: the **Model** alias, priority 7, up to **Answer length** tokens, a fixed system prompt and the prompt text.

## The system prompt

> You are a voice assistant running on a small embedded board. You hear a spoken command and your answer is read aloud. Answer in one or two short plain sentences. No lists, no markdown, no emoji. If you do not know, say so briefly.

## The prompt

With no remembered turns the prompt is the command alone, which is what a chat model answers best. With some, they come first as a short transcript:

```
Earlier in this conversation:
Q: <earlier command>
A: <earlier answer>

Now answer this: <this command>
```

## Choosing a model

Any alias the `npu-infer` catalog serves. `qwen3.5-0.8b` (default) answers fastest; `qwen3-4b` answers better and costs a load when it is not resident. A reasoning model's `<think>` text is removed before the answer is spoken.

## What is spoken

The answer is stripped of reasoning blocks, markdown marks and extra whitespace and capped at 400 characters, at a sentence end where there is one.
pages.setup:
# Set up

> Run it from a shell, then place it on the node.

## From a shell

```
cog-assistant --once --simulate                         # canned commands and answers
cog-assistant --once --replay commands.jsonl            # lines {"text": "..."} to the real service
cog-assistant                                           # continuous; answers transcript/wake0
```

Each answer is printed as `{"command", "reply", "ok"}` and, with a broker, published.

## Placed on a node

Place `assistant` in the same project as `wake-word` and `npu-infer`. Its `cog.toml` declares the inputs `transcript` and `svc.infer` and the outputs `transcript` and `telemetry`. It declares no device.
pages.start:
# Start here

> Answer what was asked, out loud, with the language model the node already has.

`assistant` takes each command `wake-word` publishes, asks the node's inference service, and publishes the answer on `transcript/reply0`. The `tts` cog speaks that topic.

## The short path

1. **Have the loop's front half.** `audio-in`, `asr`, `wake-word`. → see their guides
2. **Have the inference service.** `npu-infer` must be placed and serving `svc.infer/venq-npu` with the model you choose. → see **The model**
3. **Try it without either.** `cog-assistant --once --simulate` answers two canned commands.
4. **Place it.** → see **Set up**

## How the signal flows

```diagram
flow
```

## Honest limits

- The answer arrives after the recognizer, the queue and the model. On the NPU a small model takes a few seconds; a model that is not loaded takes ten more. The loop is a conversation, not an instant reply.
- The NPU is shared. This cog calls at priority 7, above background work, and below nothing else it can control.
- It remembers the last two exchanges in the prompt only; nothing is stored.
- A language model can be wrong. Do not give it actions to take without a check; this cog only speaks.
pages.troubleshoot:
# Troubleshoot

> What each failure looks like and what to do.

## The reply is "Sorry, I could not reach my language model."

`last_error` says why.

| `last_error` starts with | Meaning | Do this |
|---|---|---|
| `unavailable` | nobody serves `svc.infer/<service>` | place `npu-infer`; check the **Inference service** name |
| `timeout` | the queue or a model load took longer than **Call timeout** | raise it, or use a model that is already resident |
| `service_error` | the service refused the request, for example an unknown model | the message lists the models it serves |
| `unauthorized` | the cog was placed without its `svc.infer` input | place the package again |
| `the model's answer was empty` | only reasoning text came back | raise **Answer length** |

## No reply at all

`commands` is zero: `wake-word` publishes nothing. Check **Command source** against its **Name**.

## Answers ignore what was said before

**Remembered turns** is 0, or the earlier turns failed (a failed turn is not remembered).

# Sensor guide for assistant (WeftOS ADR-104 sensor-guide format, schema 1).
# Pages are Markdown files next to this one (guide/<page>.md).

schema = 1
title = "A voice assistant on the node's language model"
sensor = "Commands from wake-word, answers from the npu-infer service"
cog = "assistant"
cog_version = "0.1.0"
medical = false
pages = ["start", "model", "setup", "troubleshoot", "api"]

# Checklist step ids the companion app links to a page.
[links]
cog_installed = "setup"
cog_running = "setup"
model = "model"
no_source = "troubleshoot"

# Signal flow, left to right.
[[flow]]
name = "transcript/wake0"
detail = "a command"

[[flow]]
name = "assistant cog"
detail = "prompt, last turns"

[[flow]]
name = "svc.infer"
detail = "npu-infer, infer.v1"

[[flow]]
name = "transcript/reply0"
detail = "the answer, for speech"
